rows.note: These stocks sit in Venus's shared pool with other coins. Dollars borrowed are an estimate: each account's borrow times the share of its borrowing power that comes from these stocks. Accounts that use only these stocks as collateral have borrowed $192.0K. How full and the yearly cost are not available. Borrowing the stock tokens themselves is turned off.

borrowEstimate.method: Pro-rata from onchain balances at BSC block 126,590,360. Each account's borrow is multiplied by the share of its borrowing power that comes from bStock collateral.
